items.title: Super Micro Computer and Dell Climb 6%, Hewlett Packard Enterprise Gains 2% as AI Server Stocks Rebound From Election Sell-Off
items.summary: Record AI backlogs and steady earnest estimates sit on one side, while cash burn, heavy debt, and fresh political threats to data center construction sit on the other. Which AI server maker has the most to lose if the bounce fades?

items.title: Dell Rises 5% as AI Stocks Rebound From Post-Midterm Selloff
items.summary: Key TakeawaysDell jumped 5% today as AI stocks, Super Micro Computer among them, bounced back from Thursday’s post-midterm selloff. Analysts kept their Dell estimates steady as the stock lost about 45% in a month.

items.title: Supermicro Stock In Focus After Earnings Beat And Higher 2027 Sales Outlook
items.summary: Super Micro Computer reported first quarter fiscal 2027 sales of US$19.95b and net income of US$1.59b. The company then issued guidance calling for US$19.5b to US$21.5b in second quarter revenue and US$72b to US$82b in full year 2027 net sales. AI systems accounted for about 71% of quarterly sales, with one large data center client contributing 44% of revenue. items.title: Super Micro Sinks 10%, ASE Technology Holding Co. Down 17%, Celestica Down 13% as AI Hardware Selloff Deepens
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSuper Micro Computer fell 10% today with no company news, as AI hardware selling continued after Democrats’ midterm wins. Celestica, ASE Technology and Everpure fell harder on fears that data center building could slow.
